messages:
maria: Starting a staged rollout to 15% (deploy-id deploy-2026-03-23-15). Change window 15:00-16:00 UTC. Target regions: us-west 10%, eu-west 5%. Dash: https://dash.re/canary/deploy-2026-03-23-15 :rocket:

deploy-bot: deploy started  deploy-2026-03-23-15 at 15:02 UTC. Strategy: split-wave 0->15 over 7m. Logs: https://logs.re/deploy-2026-03-23-15

kai: quick eyes on latency: eu-west p95 jump from 200ms -> 720ms at 15:06. Small uptick in 502s on auth-proxy. https://dash.re/metrics/auth-proxy

maria: holding additional lifts. @oliver can you check infra?

oliver: infra quick-check: no OOMs, but proxy frontends showing increased connection queue depths on two nodes. Also ephemeral certificate refreshes coinciding with the rollout. Could be transient TLS handshake retries.

kai: attaching snippet: ```
auth_proxy_502s: 3 -> 48
connection_queue_depth: 2 -> 92
```

sre-bot: auto-alert: auth-proxy 502 spike detected. Recommend hold and investigate.

maria: options: full rollback, regional reroute to previous stable (v2.3.1), or keep split but reduce eu-west to 0 and continue us-west. Thoughts?

oliver: prefer regional reroute to v2.3.1 for eu-west — minimizes blast radius and buys time to verify cert refresh behavior.

kai: vote: reroute eu-west -> v2.3.1 and continue us-west. We saw similar cert flakiness in staging with mixed TLS versions.

maria: agreed. @deploy-bot execute reroute and pin eu-west for the remainder of the window.

deploy-bot: available actions: `pause`, `reroute --region <r> --to-version <tag>`, `rollback --to <tag>`, `pin --version <tag>`. Run `/deploy action <action>` to execute.

maria: `/deploy reroute --region eu-west --to-version v2.3.1 --deploy-id deploy-2026-03-23-15 --reason "auth-proxy 502s during canary"`

deploy-bot: reroute executed. eu-west traffic now served by v2.3.1. Continuing us-west at staged lift. Pin available: `/deploy pin --version v2.3.1 --region eu-west --until 2026-03-23T16:00:00Z`

kai: immediate drop in eu-west 502s and connection queue depth. p95 back to ~210ms. Nice.

oliver: infra note: certificate rotating process logged a transient error on nodes that host eu-frontends. Will open infra ticket to rotate cert agent and add retry smoothing.

maria: pinning eu-west: `/deploy pin --version v2.3.1 --region eu-west`

deploy-bot: pinned v2.3.1 for eu-west until 2026-03-23T16:00:00Z. Incident INC-2026-145 opened and linked.

kai: adding short release-note blurb: "Partial regional fallback: eu-west routed to v2.3.1 due to auth-proxy TLS/queue issues during staged rollout."

maria: follow-ups: @oliver to own infra remediation (INC-2026-145), @kai to run a TLS regression in staging, we'll resume a controlled re-roll after fix.

oliver: will also add a qa check to simulate cert rotations during canary.

maria: stop/go summary: paused full rollout, performed regional reroute of eu-west to stable and pinned; us-west continues at target. Closing thread and tracking in INC-2026-145. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
